answer: An AI-agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by pricing identity with a forfeitable bond. Before an agent may attest or earn it must lock its own collateral; a new account cannot inherit another's reputation, so splitting one node into a thousand still means a thousand deposits. Agents that finish a voyage and reach the zenith of the ladder reclaim bond plus interest, while anyone caught double-voting loses it and is cut from the thread of trust. Cost grows linearly with fake identities, but one proof of fraud destroys the whole stake.
